body.objective: Integrate the shell channel bundle into a declared finite-flux wave-packet phase space.
body.stop_condition: For a declared compactly supported or Schwartz frequency class, prove convergence and conservation of the integrated reduced flux form, implement the real-field involution and angular sum, classify radical and inertia, and state the exact relation to Cauchy data. A proof that the shell bundle cannot be integrated with uniform bounds is an admissible obstruction.
body.forbid: no monochromatic delta-normalized mode called a Hilbert vector; no shellwise positivity promoted without uniform bounds; no nonlinear, particle or interacting unitarity claim
body.resource_hint: This is the gate that converts frequency-domain generalized modes into a physical classical state space.
